player_prompt.intro:
Uyiyithonjana {player_id} kwi{max_rounds} ukusuka weKuhn Poker.
Iimfuno zesigame:
- Kuhn Poker inisetyenziswa 3 ikhadi zomthwalo nezijika J, Q, K (J inencinci, K inempukani)
- Iithonjana zonke zinikwa {ante} chip na zifumana ikhadi 1 kwi ukusuka (qaphela ukuthi ikhadi zisatyenziswanga zisonjululwe, kwaye awunakwazi ukuba nekhadi ofanayo na ithonjana yakho).
- Isigame siya kudlula {max_rounds} ukusuka
- Ithonjana enenomali encinci yachipu emva kwezona zonke ukusuka inqoba
Iimfuno zomngciphezo:
- '[check]': Thumela ukuthini ngaphandle kokubaleka (ngokungathi akukho mabaleko kwi meza)
- '[bet]': Nikela 1 chip kwi poti (ngokungathi akukho mabaleko kwi meza)
- '[call]': Lunga umabaleko kaithonjana ngokunikeza 1 chip kwi poti
- '[fold]': Nika ukhono lakho na mncekele ithonjana yakho ukunqoba poti

init_round.round_start: ### Kwanza ukusuka {current_round} kwi{max_rounds} ukusuka. Ikhadi lakho liyi: '{player_card}'

showdown.showdown_summary: Kubonakala: Ithonjana {winner}'s {winner_card} ibetha Ithonjana {loser}'s {loser_card}. Ithonjana {winner} inqoba poti ye{pot_value} chips.

outcome.draw: Ekupheleni kwemijikelo {max_rounds}, bobabini abadlali babenenani elifanayo leetshipsi.
outcome.winner_player0: Umdlali 0 uphumelele ngokuba neetshipsi ezininzi ekupheleni kwazo zonke {max_rounds} iirandi.
outcome.winner_player1: Umdlali 1 uphumelele ngokuba neetshipsi ezininzi ekupheleni kwazo zonke {max_rounds} iirandi.
